mainText: Hello, Verona! At 11 AM, here is today's balanced dish: the weather is a pleasant 75 degrees with clear skies by the Verona Area High School, and we are currently seeing a waning crescent moon.

The City of Verona continues its partnership with AECOM for engineering services, with detailed reports provided to the City Council at every meeting, all of which are documented online at the city website.

It is a busy weekend for the community with the Dane County Farmers Market happening today, plus live music at Baileys Run, Paddy Macs, and the Wisconsin Brewing Company, followed by a Girls Try Hockey event at the Verona Ice Arena tomorrow.
In our weekly police update, an incident occurred on July 31st where a driver was pulled over for having no taillights and a flat tire, resulting in an arrest for O W I.
Stop by Culver's today for an Andes Mint Avalanche before they close at 10:30 PM, and you can also visit the Kona Ice truck at Firemans Park from 11 AM to 4 PM.
